Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to trash a digivolution card, then use this effect to digivolve it from the trash?

Card Q&A.a:
No, you can't. EX9-070 [Meat]'s  effect is a [Main] effect timing, so you can only declare its activation when there is no unresolved processing. You can't declare activation of EX9-070 [Meat]'s  effect while this card's [When Attacking] effect is still processing.
